# SORTS: The Word Library

> SORTS is an ad-free word puzzle game for iPhone and iPad by White Wiki
> (whitewiki.org), listed on the App Store as "SORTS: Cosy Letterpress Words".
> Players trace words across a board of chunky letter blocks, up, down, left or right
> with turns allowed (no diagonals); any real word of three letters or more scores on
> lift-off, scored blocks burst, and matching inks chain into cascades. Free to
> download; one optional purchase; no ads; no subscription.

## Key facts
- Full name: SORTS: The Word Library. Platform: iOS and iPadOS, with a layout made for
  iPhone Duo. Status: live on the App Store; current version 1.4 (October 2026).
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sorts-word-trace-puzzle-game/id6790195358
- Campaign: 600 hand-tuned levels across six engraved storybooks (a hundred to a book),
  four chapters per book sealed by page gates. Books: A Pocketful of North, The Hungry
  Spoon, Harbour Lights, The Moon's Spare Key, The Tinker's Drawer, The Turning Year.
- Seasonal book: The Patchwork Man, a cosy retelling after Mary Shelley's Frankenstein,
  a hundred levels, free for everyone, with a season ledger of keepsakes.
- Difficulty: Hard and Super Hard levels carry wax seals; other levels can set their
  page marks by the player's form (a Settings switch turns this off).
- Modes: the Daily Edition (one shared puzzle a day, streaks), the Compositor's Cabinet
  (a letterpress match-3: match inks, then print a word for double score), Endless
  ("The Book With No Last Page"), same-room 60-second duels over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
  with no internet needed.
- Social: friends (codes or In the Room), Guilds of up to 5 players pooling weekly
  points, the Guild Library and Commonplace Book, the Guild League, and a weekly
  Forbidden Section volume a guild opens together. Game Center leaderboards.
- What is free: Books One and Two (200 levels), the seasonal book, the Daily Edition,
  duels, friends, guilds, the Forbidden Section, three Endless runs and one Cabinet
  bed a day.
- The Full Library: one non-consumable purchase that opens Books Three to Six (400
  levels) and every campaign book added later, unlimited Endless and Cabinet, the
  premium track of every season ledger, and the Patron's Set of cosmetics. Players from
  before version 1.4 and former Pressroom Pass holders get it free. Coins and the
  Pressroom Pass were retired in 1.4.
- Pages: earned by playing, never sold; spent in the Bindery on titles, inks and tile
  styles.
- Sound and feel: recorded sound effects, music and haptics, each with its own switch.
- Accessibility: colour-blind shapes, a relaxed clock, VoiceOver, Switch Control,
  Dynamic Type, Bold Text, Increase Contrast and Reduce Motion.
- Privacy: no ads, no third-party advertising or analytics SDKs, no data sold. Player
  data lives in Apple iCloud and Game Center; purchases are handled by Apple.
